name: ═══════════════ TELEGRAM INTERFACE FOR GATES ═══════════════
info:
## Gate Telegram Interface

Provides Telegram bot commands for gate control and monitoring.

### Commands:
- /gate_open - Open main gate
- /gate_status - Get gate status
- /gate_help - Show gate commands

### Notifications:
- Automatic alerts when gate power status changes
- Command execution confirmations
- Error notifications

### Dependencies:
- Requires: 200-gate-base-config.json
- Requires: telegram_bot_config (from 50-telegram-interface.json)
- Uses: Same Telegram bot as server management
